newsitem.title: USA: Abercrombie & Fitch confirms Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Abercrombie & Fitch confirms Q4 earnings.

text.p: Abercrombie & Fitch Co said on Wednesday it confirmed Wall Street expectations for its fourth quarter earnings at $0.39 per share.
"Earlier this week, a report was circulated that inaccurately suggested Abercrombie & Fitch would have a disappointing fourth quarter," it said.

"(But) Abercrombie & Fitch had a good Christmas, in what proved to be a difficult and highly promotional retail environment. Simply said, we remain on track to meet Wall Street earnings expectations for the fourth quarter," it added.

Earnings data for the year-earlier fourth quarter were not immediately available. The retail clothing company, which went public in September, reported a profit of $0.09 per share for the third quarter of 1996.
